name: Resume API
description: Profile, work experience, education, skills, certifications, hobbies, and goals — served as JSON or Markdown, scoped to your own Clerk identity.

name: Ledger API
description: Double-entry bookkeeping — accounts, transactions, and immutable entries, with derived balances and idempotent posting. IAM-authenticated (SigV4), meant for other services to call rather than end users directly.
